quote: We introduced a novel ensemble watermarking method for large language models, specifically generative transformer models.

We used three LLMs, Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.2 3B, and Mistral 7B. We create prompts with human baselines, randomly select texts from the C4 RealNewsLike dataset, trim a fixed length of tokens as "baseline" completions from the end, and treat the remaining tokens as the prompt. Our method generates watermarked text by manipulating logits with dynamic keys.
We used three LLMs, Llama 3.1 8B , Llama 3.2 3B, and Mistral 7B . We utilized the logits processor of Hugging Face  to manipulate the generation.
